Abebook.description: Oxford University Press paperback reprint of Harrison's collection of twentieth-century critical essays on Vergil's Aeneid, first published in 1990 in the Oxford Readings in Classical Studies series; the number line on the copyright page indicates a later impression. Trade paperback in the dark blue laminate wrappers, no dust jacket as issued; the spine lettering is crisp and unfaded. A very good copy: the wrappers are rubbed and scuffed with light edge wear, the lower fore-corner of the front panel is bumped and creased, and there is a crease along the spine fold with light wear at the head and tail. A previous owner's name is written in pen on the inside cover and a previous reader has left faint pencil marginal lines in places, but the text is otherwise clean and the fore-edge unspotted. Binding sound and the text block complete, opening flat without cracking.
